# Issue key absence is not an error

A Jira issue key with no matching issue (e.g., deleted, wrong project, typo in a PR title) is silently omitted from get_issues results; only a source outage (e.g., bad credentials, network) is a loud failure.

To avoid treating normal absence of issue data as a collector outage, ensuring robustness when linked issues are missing.
